title: DocumentModel
description: Schema for a legal document record managed within the Attorney Portal. Covers all document types: submitted by agents/lenders and uploaded by the attorney.

name.description: Human-readable document name displayed in the portal.

category.description: Document category. Determines which roles may upload and review. Court Order, Settlement Agreement, and Closing Verification are attorney-only upload categories.

transactionId.description: The transaction this document belongs to.

uploadedBy.description: Actor ID of the person who uploaded this document.

uploaderRole.description: Role of the person who uploaded this document. AG=Agent, AT=Attorney, LN=Lender, TC=Transaction Coordinator, CL=Client.

uploadedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the document was uploaded.

status.description: Current review status of the document. Only the attorney (AT) can move a document to Approved or Rejected.

reviewedBy.description: Actor ID of the attorney who reviewed this document. Null if not yet reviewed.

reviewedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the attorney completed review. Null if not yet reviewed.

rejectionReason.description: Required reason provided by the attorney when rejecting a document. Null for all non-rejected documents.

fileType.description: MIME type category of the uploaded file. Only PDF and DOCX are accepted.

fileSizeBytes.description: File size in bytes. Maximum accepted size is 52,428,800 bytes (50MB).

version.description: Document version number. Increments when a new version of the same document is uploaded to replace a rejected one.
